basics.name: Miqayel Petrosyan
basics.title: Full Stack Web Developer
summary: Full Stack Web Developer building products end-to-end with PHP / Laravel backends and Vue 3 / Nuxt frontends — Telegram bots & mini-apps, browser extensions and modern web applications.
I also work with Node.js and Nest.js for backend services alongside PHP/Laravel, and write clean, functional and user-centric code.
highlights: Shipped production apps: event platform Rocker.am, equipment rental platform Rentall.am, artist portfolio AraxAlice.com and Telegram assistant SheriffBot.
Built Telegram bots and mini-apps with scheduling, moderation, AI chat summaries, analytics and a content calendar.
Developed Chrome extensions: Volume Max sound booster and the LinkedIn Recruiter Toolkit bulk resume/CSV exporter.
Solid foundation in PHP/Laravel, MySQL, Redis, REST APIs, Git and Linux-friendly tooling.
Also experienced with Node.js and Nest.js for backend services.

bullets: Design and build full-stack web applications — Laravel/PHP REST backends with Vue 3, Nuxt and Inertia.js frontends, MySQL and Redis (Rocker.am, Rentall.am, AraxAlice.com).
Develop Telegram bots and mini-apps: SheriffBot with post scheduling, anti-spam moderation, AI-powered summaries, analytics and a visual content calendar.
Ship browser extensions used by real users: Volume Max audio booster and the LinkedIn Recruiter Toolkit resume/CSV exporter.
Integrate payment flows, admin panels (Filament/Livewire) and third-party APIs where the product needs them.
experience.stack: PHP, Laravel, Vue 3, Nuxt, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, PostgreSql,Eloquent ORM, CI/CD, PM2, PHPUnit, Laravel Horizon, Redis, Telegram Bot API, Git

bullets: Restored a hacked scientific-topic website — closed all security holes and removed a backdoor. The site was under constant attack from bots and users attempting to break into the admin panel, so I restricted external requests at the Nginx level. Also added a significant amount of new functionality and continue to maintain and support the project.
experience.stack: PHP, Wordpress, JavaScript, Nginx, Linux, Git, MySQL

bullets: Built a course creation and sales platform (with a blog) for AML training courses.
Developed a resort/leisure-zone site with room reservation based on real-time availability, plus tour, activity, and restaurant booking.
Implemented mass mailing to all registered users.
Deployed and configured Linux VPS environments with Nginx.
experience.stack: PHP, Laravel, Inertia, Vue, Nuxt, MySQL, Eloquent ORM, CI/CD, PM2, PHPUnit, Redis, Git, Nginx, Linux

bullets: Led the complete refactoring and migration of a legacy PHP 5.2 application to Laravel 10, improving system security, maintainability, and code quality.
experience.stack: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Git, Eloquent ORM

bullets: Engineered a geolocation-based dating platform with real-time location matching and user discovery features.

Developed an HR tool to automate the interview process: inviting a candidate to the next interview stage via email with a single click, allowing HR to leave comments at each stage, and with one click either advancing the candidate to the next stage or rejecting them.
Contributed across multiple concurrent client projects covering frontend, backend, and database work.
experience.stack: PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, MySQL, Eloquent ORM
